implementation_outline: Define authorization, provenance, rate limits and data schema.
Implement timeouts, status checks and schema validation.
Build data storage and a user-facing monitoring view.
Test stale/error states, logging redaction and recovery.
key_features: Validate data and store selected records
Handle stale, unavailable or invalid data
answer.acceptance_summary: The application provides clear feedback when data are unavailable, invalid or outdated.
